notes.roof: Automatic 'no overhang' warning is a false alarm: the renders show the eaves overhanging all round; the balcony under the cross gable confuses the check.

notes.artefacts: Same broken diagonal slab path as L1.

visual.summary: Adds the noble look: a front balcony on stone brick porch columns, red wall banners, shutters, flower boxes, lantern posts, garden flowers, bookshelves and a lectern inside.
problems: Garden path still joins only at corners (cobblestone slabs y0 around x10..13, z1..9): make it continuous.
Reach: 196 of 297 reached; unreached are roof slopes, eaves and the balcony floor (y5 x3..7 z1..2), which builders can place from the ground: fine.
